description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own speed and efficiency for machine learning training and serving systems, working from low-level GPU code up to multi-machine deployments. You will profile, tune and harden these systems alongside a small, senior technical group.
 What you'll do
 - Improve GPU and system performance for model training and serving.
 - Find and resolve slowdowns across the hardware, memory, software and cluster layers.
 - Write low-level GPU optimizations using CUDA and Triton.
 - Design and improve distributed training and serving engines.
 - Own communication performance between GPUs and machines, including high-speed networking and disaggregated serving.
 - Build benchmarking and regression tooling so performance improvements hold up in production.
 - Co-design kernels, runtimes and models with the underlying hardware in mind.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Hands-on experience writing custom GPU kernels for NVIDIA hardware.
 - Has built core capabilities inside a widely used model training or serving framework, rather than only deploying or integrating it.
 - Degree in computer science or a related quantitative field; recent graduates should come from a top program.
 - A year or more of current, professional experience in machine learning infrastructure or GPU tuning.
 - Track record of speeding up model execution at the hardware, runtime and multi-machine levels.
 - Strong grounding in machine learning and computer science fundamentals.
 Bonus points
 - Background tuning generative models that work with visual or other non-text data.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 230,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - California, United States
 - On-site, 5 days a week in the office
 - Full-time
